manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the red block using the left arm, then transfer it to the right arm and place it on the blue pad.

Task description: Operate the red rectangular block currently to the left of the blue mat. The left arm picks it up and hands it to the right arm, which then places it on the blue mat on the right.

Success criteria: The red long block is on the blue mat, with the center of its bottom face near the center of the mat's top and resting at mat height; the right gripper is open and has released the block.

## Execution tips

- Place both fingers on flat areas of opposite sides of the long block, away from the edges, with an opening slightly wider than the grasp width. Before closing, confirm the fingers are truly on opposite sides.
- During handoff, grip different heights on the side with the two grippers, leaving the receiving side enough room for full pad contact. Release the left gripper only after confirming that the right gripper holds securely.
- Choose a handoff or pose-adjustment location with ample clearance, leaving room around the block's lower end and both grippers. Avoid sweeping into the blue-and-white box in the center or the can to the right of the mat.
- Keep the rectangular block upright during placement if possible. Lower slowly as its bottom approaches the mat and open the right gripper only after confirming the mat supports it, reducing tipping.
